title: SecRepoBench: Benchmarking Code Agents for Secure Code Completion in Real-World Repositories
authors_zh: Chihao Shen, Connor Dilgren, Purva Chiniya, Luke Griffith, Yu Ding, Yizheng Chen
paper_type_zh: 仓库级安全代码补全基准
best_for_zh: 研究安全代码代理、仓库级补全或执行式代码验证的研究者。
one_line: SecRepoBench uses paired developer tests and exploit checks on 318 real C/C++ repository holes to measure whether code agents produce both functional and secure completions.
SecRepoBench 在 318 个真实 C/C++ 仓库缺口上以开发者测试与漏洞利用复验共同衡量补全的功能和安全性。
why: It turns security-sensitive completion into a joint executable outcome rather than a text-match or compilation-only task.
inclusion_reason: SecRepoBench provides executable repository-level security-completion tasks with functional and security outcomes as a joint programmatic contract.

title: Problem
问题
html: Existing secure-code benchmarks often use isolated snippets or synthetic vulnerabilities and check only compilation or functional tests, making it difficult to assess whether agents can preserve both functionality and security in real repositories. SecRepoBench places missing code back into complete C/C++ projects, requiring models to inspect dependencies and call relations before completing implementations that pass developer and security validation. Its goal is an executable repository-level evaluation surface rather than training one specific model.
现有安全代码生成基准多使用孤立片段或人为漏洞，只检查补丁是否编译或通过功能测试，难以判断代理在真实仓库上下文中能否同时保持功能和安全。SecRepoBench 将缺失代码位置放回完整 C/C++ 项目，要求模型阅读依赖和调用关系后补全实现，并通过开发者测试与安全复验。其目标不是训练单一模型，而是提供可执行、可比较的仓库级安全补全评测面。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SecRepoBench contains 318 tasks from 27 real C/C++ repositories covering 15 CWE categories. Each instance records the repository revision, completion location, context, reference implementation, build and test commands, and security-validation assets. Tasks are extracted from real security fixes or security-sensitive code, verified so that removing the target implementation breaks the baseline and the reference completion compiles, passes developer tests, and survives OSS-Fuzz-style validation. The reward contract is functional correctness plus specified security behavior, not textual similarity.

SecRepoBench 包含 318 个任务，来自 27 个真实 C/C++ 仓库并覆盖 15 类 CWE。每条实例保存仓库版本、补全位置、上下文、参考实现、构建与测试命令以及安全验证资产。构建者从真实安全修复或安全敏感代码中提取任务，先确保删除目标实现后基线失败，再确认参考补全能够编译、通过开发者单测并经 OSS-Fuzz 等机制复验。最终 reward contract 是“功能正确且不触发指定安全失败”，而不是文本相似度。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select security tasks: Locate CWE-related functions or completion sites in real repositories and freeze commits and build dependencies.
  1. Create holes: Remove the target implementation and produce a task description while preserving enough repository context for retrieval.
  1. Build oracles: Run compilation, original developer tests, and security or fuzz tests, confirming that the broken baseline fails and the reference implementation passes.
  1. Evaluate agents: Apply patches inside containers and score them under identical commands using both functional and security conditions. Reproduction must fix containers, compilers, fuzzer seeds, timeouts, and repository licences.

1. 选择安全任务： 从真实仓库定位与 CWE 相关的函数或补全位置，冻结提交和构建依赖。
  1. 构造缺口： 删除目标实现并生成问题描述，保留足够仓库上下文供模型检索。
  1. 建立 oracle： 运行编译、原开发者单测和安全测试/模糊测试，确认错误基线失败且参考实现通过。
  1. 评测代理： 将补丁应用到容器，在相同命令下执行并按功能、安全双条件判分。复现需固定容器、编译器、fuzzer 种子、超时和仓库许可。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates about 28 standalone LLMs and 13 code agents across three agent frameworks on 318 tasks. Code agents substantially outperform models that see only local prompts, yet strong agents still often pass functional tests while failing security checks, or vice versa. SecRepoBench is also markedly harder than prior snippet-level security benchmarks. This supports the importance of repository context and execution feedback, but the tasks focus on C/C++ and selected CWE classes and do not represent all vulnerabilities.
论文在 318 个任务上评测约 28 个独立 LLM 与 13 个代码代理，覆盖三类代理框架。总体结果显示代码代理显著优于只看局部提示的 standalone 模型，但即使较强代理也经常出现“功能测试通过而安全检查失败”或相反的情况；SecRepoBench 也明显难于此前片段级安全基准。该证据支持仓库检索和执行反馈的重要性，但任务集中于 C/C++ 与指定 CWE，无法代表所有安全缺陷。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier secure-completion datasets usually pair vulnerable snippets with fixes and evaluate by exact match, static scanning, or one test suite. SecRepoBench moves secure completion into buildable real repositories and requires both functional tests and dynamic security validation. Agents must retrieve cross-file context instead of classifying a single snippet. The innovation is primarily task extraction and dual-oracle evaluation, not a new vulnerability-detection model.
既有安全补全数据通常把漏洞片段与修复文本配对，评价也常依赖 exact match、静态扫描或单一测试。SecRepoBench 的变化是把安全补全放入可构建真实仓库，并要求功能测试与动态安全验证共同成立；代理必须跨文件检索上下文，而不是仅对一段代码做分类。创新主要在任务抽取和双 oracle 评测，不是新的漏洞检测模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Incomplete tests: Passing developer tests and fuzzing does not prove the absence of vulnerabilities; unvisited paths may remain unsafe, requiring static analysis and manual audits.
  1. Language and CWE bias: The 27 C/C++ repositories and 15 CWE classes do not generalize to memory-safe languages, web logic flaws, or supply-chain risks.
  1. Environment cost: Container builds, compilation, and fuzzing are expensive and can be nondeterministic. Reproduction must record seeds, timeouts, tool versions, and failure attribution.

1. 测试不完备： 通过开发者测试和 fuzzer 不等于没有安全漏洞；未触达路径仍可能隐藏问题，应补充静态分析和人工审计。
  1. 语言与 CWE 偏置： 只覆盖 27 个 C/C++ 仓库和 15 类 CWE，不能外推到内存安全语言、Web 逻辑漏洞或供应链风险。
  1. 环境成本： 容器构建、编译和模糊测试昂贵且可能非确定；复现必须记录种子、超时、工具版本及失败归因。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate secure coding agents: Run agent patches in fixed containers and report compilation, functional-test, security-test, and joint-pass rates separately.
  1. Train verifiers: Convert candidate patches and functional/security execution outcomes into multi-label reward records for code reward models.
  1. Build new tasks: Reuse the real-fix localisation, implementation removal, and dual-oracle filtering pipeline on other repositories. Without security regressions or distributable dependencies, ordinary unit tests should not be labelled as proof of security.

1. 安全代码代理评测： 用固定容器运行代理补丁，分别报告编译、功能测试、安全测试和最终双通过率。
  1. 训练 verifier： 将候选补丁及功能/安全执行结果转为多标签 reward records，训练代码奖励模型。
  1. 构造新任务： 复用真实修复定位、删除实现和双 oracle 过滤流程扩展其他仓库。若缺少安全回归测试或无法合法分发依赖，不应仅凭普通单测构造“安全正确”标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SecRepoBench jointly evaluates functionality and 15 CWE categories on 318 real-repository C/C++ completion tasks.
  2. Method takeaway: Freeze commits, remove implementations, build containers, run developer tests, and perform dynamic security validation.
  3. Data takeaway: Records contain repository context, target locations, reference patches, and execution assets, primarily for benchmarking.
  4. Evidence anchor: Results from roughly 28 LLMs and 13 agents show that repository agents are stronger but joint success remains difficult.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits secure completion and verifier research, with uncovered paths treated as the main audit risk.

1. 一句话定位： SecRepoBench 用 318 个真实仓库 C/C++ 补全任务同时检验功能与 15 类 CWE 安全性。
  2. 方法抓手： 冻结提交、挖空实现、容器构建、开发者单测和动态安全复验。
  3. 数据抓手： 每条记录包含仓库、位置、参考补丁及执行资产，主要用于 benchmark。
  4. 证据锚点： 约 28 个 LLM 与 13 个代理的结果表明仓库代理更强但双通过仍困难。
  5. 复用决定： 适合安全补全和 verifier；必须把测试未覆盖路径列为主要审计风险。
